note: ISS Phase 1 (ISS_PHASE0_SURVEY.md 5): the parameters from which Japan's representative persons are drawn. S = published figure, D = derived from one, T = declared until a source replaces it. Money in 万円 (10,000 JPY) a month. Ages and sexes come from the 2024 cohort (modern_status), prefecture populations from jpn_prefectures.json.

n_per_prefecture.label: T
n_per_prefecture.source: a run setting: 9,400 persons in all; each person's weight = prefecture population / N

household_kind_shares_adult.label: D
household_kind_shares_adult.source: HOUSEHOLD shares applied to persons without the household-to-person conversion (V085: a person-weighted share would put fewer persons in single households), from 総務省 国勢調査 2020 一般世帯の家族類型 (単独 38.0%, 夫婦のみ 20.1%, 夫婦と子供 25.0%, ひとり親と子供 9.0%, その他; rounded)

household_kind_child.label: D
household_kind_child.source: children live in the two family types with children; the split from the 2020 census counts of such households (D, rounded)

household_size.label: D
household_size.source: 国勢調査 2020 人口等基本集計 結果の概要 (published 2021-11-30): persons in 表V-1-3 / households in 表V-1-1 by family type: couple 2.00, couple + children 3.63 (3.6 kept, rounded), single parent 2.33, other 3.95; single 1 by definition (R96i (research-notes e7b5c51c); the 2.5 and 3.0 they replace were untraced roundings)

education_shares_by_age.label: D
education_shares_by_age.source: 国勢調査 2020 最終卒業学校 by age (rounded to the three classes)

student_share_by_age.label: D (T: dropouts, 浪人, 6-year courses and 専門 courses beyond two years left out)
student_share_by_age.source: 文部科学省 学校基本調査 2024 確定 (published 2024-12-18): 15-17 0.97 as before; 18-19 the 高等教育機関 entry rate 87.3%; 20-21 the 4-year 大学 59.1%; R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

participation.label: D from S counts (15-64), S (65+)
participation.source: 総務省 労働力調査 基本集計 2023 (published 2024-01-30): 労働力人口比率 男 15-64 86.8%, 女 15-64 75.2%, 65+ 25.7%; S-year (R71)

non_regular_share.label: S
non_regular_share.source: 労働力調査 基本集計 2023 (published 2024-01-30): 非正規の職員・従業員の割合 男 22.5%, 女 53.2%; S-year (R71)

unemployment_rate_start.label: S
unemployment_rate_start.source: 労働力調査 基本集計 2023 (published 2024-01-30) 完全失業率 2.6%; the monthly separation rate is derived from it and the finding rate (T) so the share holds at the start; S-year (R71)

job_finding_rate_month.label: T
job_finding_rate_month.source: a declared monthly exit rate from unemployment; the separation rate = f x u / (1 - u)

wage_regular_man_yen.label: S (一般労働者 = full-time workers, regular and non-regular alike; used here for the regular: V085)
wage_regular_man_yen.source: 厚生労働省 賃金構造基本統計調査 2023 (published 2024-03-27, 000040163660) 一般労働者 所定内給与額 男 350.9 千円, 女 262.6 千円 (monthly, 万円); R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

wage_age_curve.label: D
wage_age_curve.source: 賃金構造基本統計調査 2023 (published 2024-03-27) 年齢階級別 所定内給与 relative to the mean; R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

wage_education_factor.label: D (CHECK: R96 asks whether 2023's 大学 row includes 大学院 as 2022's did; 1.197 -> 1.161)
wage_education_factor.source: 賃金構造基本統計調査 2023 (published 2024-03-27) 学歴別 relative to the mean (専門 0.943, the 2022 basis); R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

wage_sigma.label: T
wage_sigma.source: lognormal spread within a class (T; to be derived from the 賃金構造基本統計調査 deciles, not yet done)

non_regular_wage_factor.label: D
non_regular_wage_factor.source: 賃金構造基本統計調査 2023 雇用形態別 第1表 (published 2024-03-27, 000040163766/7): 正社員以外 / 正社員 所定内 0.674; R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

unemployment_benefit_factor.label: T
unemployment_benefit_factor.source: 雇用保険 基本手当 50-80% of the former wage for 90-330 days; averaged over a spell with the uninsured, 0.30 of the regular wage (T)

pension_man_yen.label: S (the start's level; revised each April by pension_rule)
pension_man_yen.source: 厚生労働省 厚生年金保険・国民年金事業の概況 FY2023 (published 2024-12, day NF): 厚生年金 平均月額 146,429 円 (表9 受給権者); R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

pension_rule.label: S (R68: 国民年金法 Art 27-27-5 as of 2024-01; the April revision; new pensioners 67 and under; the slide's life-expectancy term -0.3%; FY2024's published revision +2.7% for all at the start's first April); D: the insured-person term from the persons' weighted 20-59 count; T: the wage change from the economy's wage index (the law's 3-year formula is not in the model); the switch at 68 stands in for the base year

student_income_man_yen.label: T (a nominal constant, not indexed: M002 G1, stated)

consumption_man_yen_month.label: S/D
consumption_man_yen_month.source: 総務省 家計調査 2023 (published 2024-02-06, 000040140604): 単身世帯 / 二人以上の世帯 消費支出 16.76 / 29.40 万円; the per-member step is D; R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

assets_median_man_yen_by_age.label: D
assets_median_man_yen_by_age.source: 家計調査 貯蓄・負債編 2023 (published 2024-05-17, 000040180979) 貯蓄現在高 mean by age of head 442 / 825 / 1,208 / 1,705 / 2,467.5 (60+ the plain average of 60s and 70+) 万円, each ÷ exp(0.8^2 / 2), the persons' lognormal draw (the medians by age are not published, NF); R96 (research-notes c86af2a0; the PM, TO_E 21:43)

housing_loan.label: T (the share among couples 30-55, not published), D (the size)
housing_loan.source: 家計調査 貯蓄・負債編 2022 (published 2023-05-12): 住宅・土地のための負債 held by 28.6% of households, the holders' mean ≈ 1,839 万円 (D, R71); the share among couples 30-55 is not published (T, 0.45 kept); S-year

health_poor_share_by_age.label: T
health_poor_share_by_age.source: 国民生活基礎調査 2022 有訴者率 rises with age; a line (T)

trait_sd.label: T
trait_sd.source: traits.gd's Big Five spread scaled to 0..1

loss_aversion.label: T
loss_aversion.source: traits.gd lam: 1.2..3.0 mean 2.0; here tied to risk tolerance

emotion_decay_month.label: T
emotion_decay_month.source: declared return rates toward the person's baseline; to be fitted to panel data (JHPS/KHPS) later

drive_base_by_age.label: T
drive_base_by_age.source: patterned on needs.gd BASE_W by age; order = survival_safety, economic_security, belonging, recognition, autonomy, growth, enjoyment, family, contribution, change

dream_share_adult.label: T
dream_share_adult.source: the share of adults holding one long-term goal of the kinds table (T; the village used 0.10 for firm founding only)

dream_kind_weights_by_age.label: T
dream_kind_weights_by_age.source: order = start_business, have_family, become_expert, financial_freedom, contribute_locally, become_known, stable_life, change_society

dream_cost_man_yen.label: T
dream_cost_man_yen.source: savings needed to reach the goal (T)

expectation_learning_rate.label: T
expectation_learning_rate.source: memory.gd learn: Q += 0.3 (r - Q), x loss aversion when worse
